big: A client switches ₹5 lakh of equity fund units to a better fund. It feels like a simple move. It is a sale and a purchase. The sale can trigger tax and an exit load. Clients rarely see the tax until it is too late.

lines: As a redemption. Equity fund units held over 12 months are long term, with gains above ₹1.25 lakh a year taxed at 12.5%. Under 12 months, 20%. The yearly ₹1.25 lakh exemption can be used to rebalance gradually or to harvest gains. Compare the expected benefit with the certain cost.

rows: long term: 12.5% above ₹1.25 lakh a year

Equity: over 12 months 12.5% above ₹1.25 lakh a year; under 12 months 20%.
Compare the expected benefit with the certain cost.
